scope: All canonical entries, route/project/assessment manifests, source-bound CPU evidence, reader/tutor delivery, CI configuration, and targeted editorial review. Not independent expert review, exhaustive mathematical proof checking, or live browser/device validation.

phases.title: Setup & first steps
phases.improvement: Make a CPU-only first success an explicit complete path; keep logical devices and the unfinished TPU bridge optional.
phases.acceptance: Fresh-machine walkthrough on each supported OS; first independent edit and explanation.

phases.title: Arrays & pure functions
phases.improvement: Connect isolated transformations into one reusable preprocessing module, retaining training-only statistics.
phases.acceptance: Unequal axes, constant feature, unseen batch and malformed input checked by a learner-owned script.

phases.title: JAX transformations
phases.improvement: Use one running problem to compose grad, vmap and jit, then ask for a transfer without showing the solution.
phases.acceptance: Independent vectorized/loop and eager/compiled comparisons with a changed batch and objective.

phases.title: State, randomness & control flow
phases.improvement: Combine keys, pytree state, scan and branching in one small persistent simulator.
phases.acceptance: A restart from a saved state reproduces the next random event and transition.

phases.title: Math & optimization
phases.improvement: Retain the mathematical depth but separate essential training prerequisites from optional deeper study; expand the synthesis assessment to match the eight added lessons.
phases.acceptance: A learner justifies validation, regularization, batch aggregation and optimizer-state decisions on a changed multifeature problem.

phases.title: Neural network training
phases.improvement: Move from synthetic shape/correctness fixtures to a fixed, documented real dataset with a baseline and failure analysis.
phases.acceptance: Dataset provenance, frozen splits, train-only preprocessing, baseline, error examples and multiseed report.

phases.title: Data & checkpoint recovery
phases.improvement: Make recovery a runnable staged project; complete asynchronous/failure-boundary instruction.
phases.acceptance: Interrupt a separate process after known boundaries, resume, compare state and data position, and reject incomplete snapshots.

phases.title: Transformers & language models
phases.improvement: Keep the periodic fixture as a wiring check, then add a small corpus project that needs contextual prediction.
phases.acceptance: Documented corpus split, simple baseline, eligible-token loss, persistent checkpoint, generation policy and failure examples.

phases.title: Performance diagnosis
phases.improvement: Complete profiling, memory and before/after measurement rather than stopping at timers and trace counters.
phases.acceptance: A saved trace with annotated bottleneck, correctness-preserving change, repeated measurements and named hardware.

phases.title: Distributed training
phases.improvement: Complete communication and recovery; provide actual multi-device evidence before promising scaling outcomes.
phases.acceptance: Global numerical reference, placement explanation, communication evidence and a measured scaling/recovery report.

phases.title: Scientific computing
phases.improvement: Author the first complete CPU inverse-problem sequence; all four specialist lessons are missing.
phases.acceptance: Known parameter recovery, conservation/stability checks, independent gradients and unseen trajectories.

phases.title: Probabilistic modeling
phases.improvement: Author a Bayesian regression sequence and diagnostics; all four specialist lessons are missing.
phases.acceptance: Prior/posterior predictive checks, chain diagnostics and uncertainty interpretation.

phases.title: Reinforcement learning
phases.improvement: Author environment, rollout, policy-gradient and evaluation lessons as one project; all four are missing.
phases.acceptance: Known transition tests, baseline policy and evaluated returns across independent seeds.

phases.title: Pallas kernels
phases.improvement: Keep the route a roadmap until kernel lessons and supported accelerator evidence exist.
phases.acceptance: Reference parity across shapes/dtypes followed by reproducible timing on named hardware.

phases.title: Autodiff & JAX internals
phases.improvement: Build out JVP/VJP, custom derivatives and lowering from the existing jaxpr lesson; reuse rather than duplicate the math-phase introduction.
phases.acceptance: A custom rule checked independently, including its domain boundaries and a changed input.

phases.title: Deployment, interoperability & edge AI
phases.improvement: Connect the framework and precision labs to a trained artifact, executable serving workload and real device evaluation.
phases.acceptance: Cross-runtime parity, calibration/accuracy report, supported operators, cold/warm latency, memory and target-device record.

phases.title: Workload operations
phases.improvement: Author one operational vertical slice before presenting five separate job capabilities; all five lessons are missing.
phases.acceptance: Versioned job, telemetry, controlled incident, verified recovery/rollback and measured resource report.

routes.title: Make it fast. Make it scale.

lessons.title: Set up your learning workspace
sections: 1. Download and unpack your workspace
2. Check that Python is installed
3. Put the terminal in the right folder
4. Create the environment and install the packages
5. Run your first saved program
6. Make one change and save your result
7. Resume when you open a new terminal
When a step fails: match the symptom
lessons.improvement: Observe a novice installing and editing the first script; report OS-specific failures and time to first independent result.

lessons.title: Meet your arrays and devices
sections: Read the table before using an API

lessons.title: Least squares, rank, and conditioning
